verse: kathayāmi yathā tathyaṃ vistareṇa yathākramam | yena vijñātamātrena khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet
ādau tāḥ pañcacakrasya pūjyā vandyāstu sarvataḥ | cakrasthā devadeveśyaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva mahārthagāḥ
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇuśvaikamano bhūtvā hṛdaye śāṃbhavaṃ param | catvāronmanatābhinnaṃ jñeyaṃ kālīkramāgame
vāgbhavaṃ tu tato yojyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tatoddharet | sthitisthaṃ tu tato rudra dvitīyaṃ viśvarūpakam
tataḥ sthitiśca saṃhāramanākhyaṃ ca tataḥ param | bhāsākhyaṃ ca tataḥ paścāt pūjayeta kramakramam
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena gurubhaktena kramagāḥ | tāsāṃ tu yoginīnāṃ ca pāraṃparyagatāni ca
mukharyā tu mahākālaṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakī | gopanīyāni nāmāni caurebhyo draviṇaṃ yathā
saṃhārād dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭeraṣṭamaṃ sthitisaṃyutam | etat tayodaśavarṇaṃ viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
ṣoḍaśāraṃ mahādika sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sutejasam | karṇikākeśarairyuktaṃ mahātīkṣṇaṃ suśobhanam
? yogīśvarīpadaṃ padaṃ paścāt prero deyān padaṃ tataḥ | eṣā tu deva deveśi caturviṃśākṣarā smṛtā
parāparepadaṃ paścāt saraditke padaṃ tataḥ | kalākalepadaṃ yojya śūnyaśāntapadaṃ tataḥ
ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
cakrākārāḥ stutāḥ sarvā bodhapāna ratākulāḥ | tatrasthāḥ parayā bhaktyā māyāvad yāstu nityaśaḥ
bhavate sarvasattvānāṃ tad vadasva vidhānataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā kramasārasya nirṇayam
sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ yad vai daśapaṃcamakaṃ viduḥ | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yat tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam
arāsu vinyaset prājña saumyarūpāvibodhataḥ | tatastu sthiticakrasya varṇānyanyāni ṣoḍaśa
śrībhairava uvāca asmin pīṭhe mahābhīme vīravīraiḥ susaṃkule | kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve catuḥṣaṣṭirmahābalāḥ
guptaṃ tu paramaṃ divyaṃ kimarthaṃ naravandite | etad vadasva me (?) vāme yathāvidhiranukramāt
tritīyasvaramārūḍhā sarvasaṃhārakārakī | pakṣāpakṣaṃ svayaṃ bhinnaṃ vilinā sā parā kalā
ālīḍhā ca nirālīḍhā  sālīḍhālīḍhakaiḥ saha ||2/30 ||
durvijñeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ sarvadhā  sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 49 ||
taptā sarvārthagarbhajñā sthitisthā viddhi tattvataḥ | ṣaṭtyāge tu acakrasthā nityā pūjyā vimarśataḥ
pūjayet sarvathā nātha svamātmānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | mūrtayaśca tataḥ pūjyāḥ siddhāśca tadanantaram
prathamaḥ  paṭalaḥ ||1/1 ||
śāstrāṇāṃ nicayaṃ pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ me tvadanugrahāt | teṣu madhyāt tamajñātaṃ jñeyaṃ kālikramaṃ yathā
ānandañca nirānandaṃ sānanda rakṣace * * *? | dvitīyāṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
amānā mānanīyā ca śivabhūtā parā kalā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
na lekhyāni ca bodhātmā na vadet sarvamadhyataḥ | na pāṭhaṃ teṣu nāmeṣu kartavyaṃ vācayā hara
tataḥ saṃjñā prakartavyā siddhānāṃ bodhudarśinī | antenākṣatipādeti teṣāṃ kuryād yathā vidhiḥ
uttamā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ gopayet prāṇavallabhe | agopyād siddhihāniḥ syād gopānāt tu phalapradā
krameṇa sarva tu * *? sthitiḥ sā sarvatomukhī | tataḥ saṃhārakāraṇī kramavijñānabhakṣaṇī
tato nityoditāṃ bhīmāṃ amātrāṃ sarvabhāsakāṃ | mātṛkāśca bahiḥsthāpya prāṇasya ca muhurmuhuḥ
śūdrī vaiśyā tathā veśyā dhāvakī nartakī tathā
nākāśaṃ na ca dīptaṃ vai na prabhāsaṃ na bhāsakam | na kṛṣṇaṃ na ca vai pītaṃ na raktaṃ lohitaṃ na ca
mahāṣaṭkaṃ tatoddhṛtya mitraśabdamataḥ param | antateti padaṃ paścād uddharet tadvidhānataḥ
dvādaśāntā nirānandā śoḍaśāntā manonmanī | punardvyaṣṭakalāyātā dvau daśaṣaṭtrita ekam
madhyaspandarathārūḍhā asvarāmbarabhedinī | vādyantā ūrdhvagā kālī hayāntā tūṣṇīgāśrutā
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāraṃ anākhyeyaṃ caturthakam | bhāsā śrutaṃ ca saddṛṣṭyā kramametat mahārthakam
yatra garbhatrayodayaṃ mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | rākākārā kuhūrūpā kuhunākāśabhakṣakī
sṛṣṭisaptamakaṃ nātha saṃhārasyāṣṭame yutam | ekādhikadaśaṃ viddhi sarvakāmaphalapradam
nirdvayā acyutā śāntā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | pakṣadvayavinirmuktā madhyamāpādamadhyagā
prāpyase paramaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me parameśāni sṛṣṭicakrasya pūjanam
agnibījaṃ tataḥ paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā siddhānāṃ tattvadarśinī
na tantre na ca siddhānte bhairave vātha yāmale | nāṇave srotabhede vā na śākte śāṃbhave na ca
recakaiḥ purakaiḥścaiva kumbhakaiśca viśeṣataḥ ||1/ 58 ||
muktinyāyena vai rudra pūjayitvā idaṃ kramam | śrībhairava uvāca sā sṛṣṭiḥ sarvagā devi kasmin sthāne tu pūjyate
na kule kaulike devi śrutaṃ me kramaśāsane | kramaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ devi raśmisthāne pratiṣṭhitam
yoginyo dvādaśa tatra yutaśca (?) tadanantaram | pīṭhāśca pīṭhasiddhāśca dūtayaśca sutejasaḥ
sakṣunyetiḥ svabhāvākhye viśvagrāsā parā citiḥ | laharīṃ prathamāṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
saṃhāracakrād deveśa saptamena śiroyutam | saptamaṃ tu vijānīyādaṣṭamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
